# Purpose
This generated header defines the network metrics metadata used by the codebase. It assigns each metric a fixed offset, a string name, a type such as `FD_METRICS_TYPE_COUNTER` or `FD_METRICS_TYPE_GAUGE`, a short description, and a converter setting. The metrics cover receive and transmit packet counts, byte totals, buffer state, XSK wakeup events, XDP drop reasons, and GRE traffic statistics. The file also declares the `FD_METRICS_NET` metadata array and the `FD_METRICS_NET_TOTAL` size constant so other code can access the full set of network metrics in a stable order.
